---
title: "Publications"
description: "A live feed of my research output, pulled automatically from Zotero. Updated on the 1st and 15th of each month."
page-layout: full
# Listing page: the share buttons in this directory's _metadata.yml are meant
# for the detail pages, not this index.
share: false
toc: false
# Two listings, not eleven (#240). The peer-reviewed papers lead in their own
# section so the record is the first thing read, and everything else — talks,
# webinars, coverage, review service — sits in one date-sorted list under a
# category filter, rather than in nine stacked headings nobody can navigate.
# The filter bar spans both listings; see assets/home.js.
# Zotero exports one record per appearance, so a talk given at several venues
# arrives as several near-identical items. scripts/update-pubs.js marks the
# most recent of each cluster `pub-listed: "yes"` and hangs the venue run off
# it, so a repeat run reads as one work presented four times (#253).
listing:
  - id: pubs-journal
    contents: "*/index.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    include:
      categories: "Journal Article"
      # Repeat appearances of one work carry no `pub-listed`, so the index
      # shows one row per work while every appearance keeps its own page (#253).
      pub-listed: "yes"
    template: ../_ejs/citation.ejs
    page-size: 100
  - id: pubs-other
    contents: "*/index.qmd"
    sort: "date desc"
    include:
      pub-listed: "yes"
    exclude:
      categories: "Journal Article"
    template: ../_ejs/citation.ejs
    page-size: 100
include-after-body:
  - text: |
      <script src="../assets/home.js"></script>
---

```{=html}
<!-- The numbers are fallbacks: scripts/update-stats.ts rewrites them at render
     time from the publications/*/index.qmd frontmatter, so they can't drift as
     the Zotero sync adds entries. The citations block is dropped entirely when
     no entry carries a `pub-citations` count yet. -->
<div class="nw-stats nw-statstrip">
<div class="nw-stat"><b data-nw-stat="pub-total">30</b><span>Publications &amp; Talks</span></div>
<div class="nw-stat"><b data-nw-stat="pub-journal">5</b><span>Journal Articles</span></div>
<div class="nw-stat"><b data-nw-stat="pub-first">12</b><span>First-Author Works</span></div>
<div class="nw-stat" data-nw-stat-block="pub-citations"><b data-nw-stat="pub-citations">14</b><span>Citations</span></div>
</div>
```

::: {.nw-pubs}

```{=html}
<!-- Chips are built from the categories actually present in the two grids, so
     a new Zotero item type appears in the filter without a code change. -->
<div class="nw-filters" data-nw-filter-for="pubs-journal,pubs-other" data-nw-filter-noun="publications"></div>
```
